about: machine-readable failure atlas: each breakdown seen in a test render, the frames, the cause, and the corrective added (only where a test revealed it)

entries.failure: front-on body with a hanging head reads as a lump
entries.cause: head pitch -45 deg during the front view
entries.repair: hold head >= 0.8 through the view switch; drop it after the turn

entries.failure: flattened ears drawn edge-on as sticks
entries.cause: flat ear tip coplanar with the ear base
entries.repair: flat tip raised/spread; ear outline bulge 0.12 -> 0.30

entries.failure: segment length drift 6 mm when lying
entries.cause: paw z spread separately from the chain

entries.failure: stance feet slide up to 7 mm
entries.cause: stance offset scaled 0.92; fore IK over-reach at stride ends

entries.failure: body in back view shows the chest bib (reads as front)
entries.cause: bib patch clipped to the torso regardless of view
entries.repair: bib becomes a switch keyed on the body view bone (sin psi_b > -0.3)

entries.failure: look-in reads as looking at the person
entries.cause: person seated inside, in the line of the muzzle
entries.repair: person restaged on the porch beside the door; door opens flat to the inner wall

entries.failure: front-on body is foreshortened to a short column; legs bunch
entries.cause: continuous body yaw through 90 deg, no separate front body drawing
entries.repair: not repaired: turn shortened to six frames so the column lasts two frames
